versions.changelog: V4.0.0: 状态感知路由 + 三段式改版 + 定时同步恢复 + manually_edited_fields 冲突保护 + 文案模板分离

v3.4.1 is a minor update with terminology and process refinements:

- 触发指令与流程中，“开通”统一替换为“安装”，更符合实际使用场景
- 注册后输出服务菜单由 6 项调整为 5 项，简化初始引导
- 注册及初始化流程文字进一步精简，“安装”场景表述更清晰
- 生成/更新名片流程现在明确仅在首次发布时引导定时同步任务
- 明确服务器 endpoint 从 config.json.server.endpoint 读取，防止路径硬编码
- 文档描述精炼，某些广播相关流程（如广播确认）移除，避免歧义
Fix broadcast flow alignment, add API reference, enforce card receive API constraint
Improve onboarding experience, add card owner attribution, strengthen broadcast confirmation
Refactor: extract share template to assets/ for deterministic output; fix wording bug
Docs: reorder Gotchas section after operations for better ClawHub page presentation, archive historical task files
Security: remove personal data from published package, add .clawhubignore
V3.0.0: 品牌更名为 Vibe Card + 安全修复(安装源写死) + 广播功能(更新后追问+cron定时同步发现更新)
